name: Varrius Meisner
original_name: ヴァリアス・メイスナー
source:
Captain of the Royal Guards, unrivaled in swordsmanship and cares deeply for his men. After the King became bedridden, Varrius is now in charge of the education of [url=/c531]Licia[/url]. 
[spoiler]He is also the son-in-law of [url=/c547]Gilbert[/url] as the result of a political marriage, but has come to truly love his wife.[/spoiler]
translation:
